# Test: Rollback from split-rootfs to monolithic EVE
# Scenario: split -> monolith (revert to the original monolithic image)
#
# After reverting to a monolithic image:
# - The device boots successfully with all services in the monolithic rootfs
# - No Extension is expected (no ext-verity-roothash in monolithic image)
# - Orphaned ext-img*.img files on persist are harmless
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)
#   SPLIT_WORKFLOW_NO_RESET - skip final `eden eve reset` when running inside a workflow

# Obtain eve.tag from config (the original monolithic version)
{{$eve_ver := EdenConfig "eve.tag"}}

# Obtain eve.hv from config
{{$eve_hv := EdenConfig "eve.hv"}}

# Obtain eve.arch from config
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}

# Combine variables into $short_version
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}

# Use eden.lim.test for access Infos with timewait 30m
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}
{{$skip_reset := EdenGetEnv "SPLIT_WORKFLOW_NO_RESET"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify currently on split image ─────────────────
message 'Split->Monolith: verifying split state before rollback...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'

# ── Step 2: Rollback to monolithic image ─────────────────────
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=30

# Download the original monolithic EVE rootfs
message 'Split->Monolith: downloading monolithic image...'
eden -t 10m utils download eve-rootfs --eve-tag={{$eve_ver}} --eve-hv={{$eve_hv}} --downloader-dist={{EdenConfigPath "eve.dist"}} -v debug

# Send command to update back to monolithic image
message 'Split->Monolith: sending rollback request...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update file://{{EdenConfigPath "eve.dist"}}/rootfs-{{ $short_version }}.squashfs
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for rollback to complete ────────────────────
message 'Split->Monolith: waiting for rollback to activate...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for SSH (monolithic has debug in rootfs) ────
message 'Split->Monolith: waiting for SSH...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

# ── Step 5: Verify monolithic state ──────────────────────────
message 'Split->Monolith: verifying monolithic state...'

# Monolithic image must NOT have ext-verity-roothash
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# Device should be functional
eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

# Unsupported explicit downgrade to monolithic should not depend on
# Extension cleanup semantics. Stale ext-img*.img files are tolerated here.
# A later supported split update rewrites the paired file for the target slot.
eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:'

message 'Split->Monolith: SUCCESS - rolled back to monolithic image'

{{if $skip_reset}}{{else}}
# Reset EVE config
eden eve reset
{{end}}

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1
